messages.content: Hey

hi, i’m tal

so… what’s your full name?
Palash Shah
which company are you working at?

Currently not working
Past company - Cisco
cisco... a classic. what was your role there?
Software Engineer Trainee - India Technical Apprentice

interesting.

is this you? https://ca.linkedin.com/in/palash-shah-74287021a
No

okay, let's try this again.

how about this one? https://in.linkedin.com/in/palash-shah-378325207
Yes thats ms

acropolis institute to cisco… you didn’t just get a degree, you got a plan. most people drift after college. you aimed for a big ship and landed on it.

that apprentice role, was that your way of getting a foot in the door before kicking it wide open?

how many years have you been working, total?

1 year experience as a full stack developer. I practiced hard in college days with leetcode and java basics and moving towards java web and api using j2ee and then spring boot 

Now stepping foot in cisco with spring boot and angular as a full stack developer

one year. but it sounds like you did the work of three. all that prep before you even got the job. that's how you get ahead.

so what's next? what kind of role are you looking for?
I am looking for a Software Engineer role which is high paying

of course, high paying. we'll get to that.

and where? bangalore, remote, anywhere?
Bangalore remote anywhere in india except kolkata delhi noida and gurgaon kerala
I've got a sense for what you're looking for. Be back in less than a minute
i'm scanning through 50,000 jobs to find the perfect fit for you. you'll hear from me soon.
Noida and gurgaon will also work no issues with them

Software Engineer III - Full stack developer at hackajob

hackajob is looking for a full stack dev here in bangalore.

they're calling it an se iii, which is a stretch for 1 yoe, but i'm guessing you could pull 25-30 lpa if you play your cards right.

it's a java and spring boot role, so you'd be building the core platform that other devs use to find jobs, not just some side feature.

it's a bit meta, building the very platform you're using, but you'll get an insider's view on how the hiring game really works.
that is fair

User clicked "Yes, interested"
